The will opens by naming Ivor Ellis Kestell of 9 Barrowglass Walk, Darnmere. The executor clause reads “my daughter Tamsin Vera Kestell”.

Tamsin Vera Kestell made the opening enquiry on 2 March and attended intake with an incomplete folder. The certified death entry records that Ivor Ellis Kestell of 9 Barrowglass Walk, Darnmere, died on 18 February 2026. The signed original will dated 7 October 2021 names Tamsin as executor, describes her as “my daughter” and leaves the residue to her outright. The certified birth entry (Darnmere entry 284 for 1969) names Tamsin as the child and Ivor as the father.
